name: fix-acceptance-rollout-canonical-agent-overlay
title: Restore acceptance rollout reviewer identity across the canonical agent environment boundary
description: Fix the production acceptance_rollout_report writer regression introduced when the parent cohort process switched to PROOF_OR_STOP_AGENT while nested reviewer commands still overlaid only LATTICE_AGENT. Preserve canonical environment precedence and fail-closed unknown-actor rejection. Add a real production-writer regression that exercises the handler, registered cohort, review_run_start/review_pass_set, and signed rollout artifact path.
